heading: Connected accounts
sub: Connect an account you hold at one of these providers, and sign in here with it. A connection is yours: nobody else can make one for you, and disconnecting it ends the sessions it started.
none: This realm offers no provider to connect.
connected: Connected — you can sign in here with it.
notConnected: You have no connection to that provider.
noSession: This service no longer knows which sign-in this page is part of, so a connection started from it could not be finished. Sign in again and connect from there.
riskRefused: An account cannot be connected from this sign-in. Sign in again and connect from there.
notConnectable: That provider cannot be connected now.
